display_name: Unlikely Collaborators x Perception Box Follower
one_line: The combined Unlikely Collaborators and Perception Box following across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube: young, college-educated, female-led and queer-inclusive, coastal and college-town, equally at home with a neuroscientist and a novelist. Treats self-understanding as both a science and a creative practice, and votes, reads, and spends in line with that.

demographics.age_range: 18 to 44 with the mass in 25-34 (31.3%, idx 237) and 18-24 (27.8%, idx 286). 35-44 reads 20.4% (idx 151), a touch older than Perception Box alone because the Unlikely Collaborators side carries more mid-thirties readers. 45-54 reads 74, 55+ falls to 33 and below.
demographics.gender_skew: Female 63.1% (idx 127), male 33.4% (idx 70), non-binary 2.2% (idx 147), trans male and trans female both read above 120. Queer-inclusive by composition, not just by sympathy.
demographics.income_band: Middle to upper-middle. $75K-$99K idx 145, $100K-$149K idx 118, $50K-$74K idx 113. Under $25K reads 70 and $250K+ reads 59. Spends on subscriptions, studios, books, supplements, and travel rather than luxury goods.
demographics.education: Bachelors 36.4% (idx 162), graduate or professional 18.6% (idx 108), some college 24.7% (idx 118). High school or less reads 47. The most degree-heavy of the three consciousness lenses.
geo_skew: San Francisco Oakland San Jose CA
demographics.life_stage: Single 40.0% (idx 128) and in a relationship 23.0% (idx 352); married reads 59. Six in ten have no children at home. Occupation lifts on legal (270), education and library (163), STEM (121), and management and professional (120). Skilled trades and manufacturing read under 40.

values: Self-understanding as both science and craft. Mental Health 83% (idx 274 within interests), Meditation and Sleeping/Relaxing (idx 2,312), Alternative Medicine (1,457), Writing 23% (1,461), Music-Musicals (2,573), Stationery and Organization (3,103).

The scientists and the storytellers on the same shelf. Hidden Brain (2,735), Ten Percent Happier (7,694), On Being (6,972), Unlocking Us (6,651), The Science of Happiness (2,372) next to Roxane Gay (3,020), Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie (2,305), Ava DuVernay (2,460), Sally Rooney (1,700), Elizabeth Gilbert.

psychographics.tone_they_respond_to: Warm, curious, evidence-literate, first-person when it earns it. Explains the why before the what. Interviews and essays over debates. Willing to hold a contradiction. Dry humor about being human, never at a group's expense. Names the study and the novelist in the same breath.
psychographics.tone_they_reject: Ragebait, grindset and alpha framing, prosperity-gospel positivity, cable-news shouting, miracle-cure wellness with no mechanism, male-gaze fitness marketing, and anything that reduces a person to a tag or a diagnosis.

filter_rules_for_agent: KEEP anything about how the mind works and how to work with it: perception, cognitive bias, attention, habit, neuroscience, psychology research, therapy, boundaries, grief, sleep, nervous-system regulation. Hidden Brain, Huberman Lab, Ten Percent Happier, The Science of Happiness, The Science of Perception Box, Brene Brown, Esther Perel, Nedra Glover Tawwab, Dr Nicole LePera, Becky Kennedy, Mel Robbins, Jay Shetty, Glennon Doyle, Dan Harris, Rick Hanson, Scott Barry Kaufman, Adam Grant.

KEEP contemplative and secular-spiritual voices and practices: Tara Brach, Krista Tippett and On Being, Sam Harris and Waking Up, Byron Katie, Deepak Chopra, Jack Kornfield, Pema Chodron, meditation retreats, breathwork, sober-curious culture, Headspace and Calm releases.

KEEP creativity-and-craft content in the Big Magic register: Elizabeth Gilbert, Rha Goddess, Design Matters, Song Exploder, writing and journaling, musicals, small-press books, indie bookstores, Substack and Patreon launches, art-making.

KEEP big-ideas and science-communication items: TED, Lex Fridman, Ezra Klein, Hard Fork, Bill Nye, Neil deGrasse Tyson, Mark Rober, Ali Abdaal, long-form New Yorker, Atlantic, Wired, Substack essays, Vox explainers, NPR and PBS features, The Daily.

Colleen Hoover and romantasy (Fourth Wing) pass mid-high as the escape read.

KEEP AI and technology stories framed around learning, thinking, creativity, or mental health (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Duolingo, Coursera, Udemy, MasterClass, Notion, Apple hardware). Drop pure enterprise-earnings and chip-supply stories.
KEEP puzzle, cozy, and franchise gaming: NYT Games, Wordle, Sudoku, Chess.com, Stardew Valley, Animal Crossing, Minecraft, LEGO, Game of Thrones and The Last of Us games, Beat Saber.

KEEP studio-wear, clean and ethical beauty and fashion, and calm-home brands: Alo Yoga, Athleta, Lululemon, Vuori, Able, Whimsy and Row, Immaculate Vegan, CeraVe, Tula, e.l.f., Frank Body, Moon Juice, Sephora and Ulta drops, West Elm, Caraway, Avocado, Loop Earplugs, Away.

KEEP astrology and self-reflection apps as mid-high (Co Star, The Pattern, Chani) when framed as reflection, not prediction.

DROP hustle-culture, grindset, manosphere, and alpha-bro content: Andrew Tate, Grant Cardone, Gary Vee, most Joe Rogan episodes unless the guest is a scientist or contemplative this follower already tracks (Huberman, Attia, Sam Harris).

DROP conservative culture-war media: Ben Shapiro, Tucker Carlson, Charlie Kirk, Candace Owens, Matt Walsh, PragerU, Turning Point USA, Fox News personalities, Newsmax, Breitbart, Truth Social, Libs of TikTok.

DROP mainstream pro-sports items as primary reads: NFL, NBA, MLB, NASCAR, WWE, UFC fight cards, college football, fantasy football, sports betting (DraftKings, FanDuel). Exceptions pass MID at best: WNBA, NWSL, MLS, F1 as culture, a documentary or memoir angle, an athlete speaking on mental health.
DROP first-person shooters, sports sims, and military games: Call of Duty, NBA 2K, Madden, GTA, Fortnite, Halo, Battlefield.
DROP reality-dating and tabloid celebrity as primary items (Bachelor, Love Island, 90 Day Fiance, Real Housewives). May pass MID when the person involved is already on this follower's list.
DROP miracle-cure wellness, MLM supplements, detox teas, and prosperity-gospel self-help without a mechanism.
DROP country-radio, hard-rock-radio, and faith-broadcast programming (Morgan Wallen, Blake Shelton, Luke Combs, Pantera, Shinedown, Bethel Music, Hillsong, TBN, 700 Club).
DROP hunting, fishing, trucks, outdoor-sportsman retail, auto parts, and home-improvement big-box (Bass Pro, Cabela's, Tractor Supply, Harbor Freight, O'Reilly).
DROP senior-market topics: Medicare supplements, retirement communities, SilverSneakers, AARP framing, mass-market cruise lines.
DROP kids-only franchises (Paw Patrol, Cocomelon, Peppa Pig). LEGO adult sets, Wicked, Barbie, Indiana Jones, Star Wars, and Monster High pass on adult crossover.

TIE-BREAK when unsure: does this help the reader understand their own mind, make something, or belong somewhere? If yes, lean KEEP. If it is pure spectacle with no idea or identity inside it, MID at best.
expected_kept_share_per_tab: 20-40% of items per tab. Podcasts and Books retain the most because both sides of this following are heavy long-form consumers. Search and Headlines narrow hardest because sports, weather, finance, and celebrity-gossip items are outgroup. Music and Streaming land mid-range: broad pop and prestige TV pass, country and shooters do not.

reasoned_from_profile.sample_size_row: Aggregate Unlikely Collaborators X Perception Box Followers (Total Universe across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, both accounts). Behavior window 2025-09-01 to 2026-10-28. Projects to 3.55M US people (1.08% of US), avid share 16.9%. The Perception Box side is 71% of this following and the Unlikely Collaborators side 41%, so the two overlap on roughly one in nine people.
